description: Ensemble arranger: pick an instrumentation — Strings, Horns, or Winds — and describe one passage; the LLM composes 2-6 voices TOGETHER (one schema-forced call). Strings/winds follow woven rules (counterpoint / chorale / interlock, register + complexity hierarchy); Horns are a funk SECTION (stabs / riffs / unison — one rhythm under the lead, James Brown punches, dance-floor bias). A mechanical validator enforces registers, density caps, per-voice monophony, stab length, and style rules. Each voice lands on its own track as one voice-group, with a category-correct placeholder sound (roles strings/brass/winds) and real-instrument registers ready for sampled libraries.
